purpose: Evaluate scale and natural-image generalization of the locked activation panel on the CMC ImageNet-100 subset without altering the completed 225-run primary confirmatory analysis.
analysis_role: post-confirmatory generalization extension; reported separately from primary confirmatory inference

dataset.name: imagenet100
dataset.source_resolution_contract: upstream CMC images have short side resized to 160 pixels
dataset.held_out_evaluation_role: upstream official validation split, used once as the held-out evaluation set

training.evaluation_partition: upstream official validation split, evaluated once after the fixed training budget
training.checkpoint_selection: none; final epoch under a fixed budget

secondary_metrics: peak training and inference GPU memory
reporting.summary: mean and sample standard deviation across five paired seeds for every model-activation condition
reporting.paired_reporting: seed-paired LGTS-f4-Alpha minus comparator differences within each backbone
reporting.inference_boundary: descriptive post-confirmatory evidence only; no re-pooling with or replacement of the locked primary analysis

resume_policy: Completed runs are skipped using run-level done.json. An interrupted run has no epoch checkpoint and restarts from epoch 1.
